Claims summarizing findings from cited external literature were not atomized as primary-study results; the extraction focuses on this paper’s own method, demonstration, measurements, limitations, and conclusions.
No funding disclosure or conflict-of-interest statement was identified in the substantive source text; none was invented.

Two internal numerical reconciliation issues are retained as calculated_from_reported_data atoms rather than silently repaired: 34 reported human-above-ceiling rungs versus a 23+13 narrative split, and 206 Claude Code-associated activities in the disclosure versus 242 AI activity-class counts in Table III.
